title: Vans Warped Tour 2026: Here’s Where to Get Affordable Tickets Online
summary: Starting on Saturday (June 13), the punk rock tour hits the road with dates across the United States.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

After making a comeback in 2025 (after a six-year hiatus), Vans Warped Tour is back in action this summer. The punk rock tour goes out on the road throughout the United States, starting Saturday (June 13) at RFK Campus in Washington, DC. The tour only features five two-day events in North America (three in the U.S., one in Canada and one in Mexico).

For 2026, a number of popular punk, emo, ska and alternative rock bands are set to perform during the tour, including Bowling For Soup, Dropkick Murphys, Enter Shikari, GWAR, Gym Class Heroes, Hawthorne Heights, Hoobastank, Jimmy Eat World , Joyce Manor, KennyHoopla, Less Than Jake, Motion City Soundtrack, MxPx, Plain White T’s, Reel Big Fish, Silverstein, Sublime, Thrice, Underoath and others. Check out a lineup of bands here .

Shop Vans Warped Tour 2026 Tickets at Ticketmaster

Tickets to the tour first went on sale through Live Nation and Ticketmaster , while the retailer’s Face Value Exchange program is an option for fans to resell tickets.

However, many of the dates have either sold out, or are very close to selling out, so one of the best ways to find Warped Tour tickets online is through third-party sites, including StubHub , SeatGeek , Vivid Seats , TicketNetwork , Gametime , Event Tickets Center and others. All online retailers guarantee authentic tickets in time for your concert. Prices may be above or below face value at times.
